title: Check If N and Its Double Exist
summary: Examine an array to determine if any element is exactly double another element, ensuring their indices are distinct.
statement: Examine an array to determine if any element is exactly double another element, ensuring their indices are distinct.
constraints: Values may be negative or zero.
hints: Check each new value against previously seen values only.
A valid earlier partner is either twice the current value or half of it when current is even.
Return on a match, then add current to seen.
Restricting matches to seen automatically enforces distinct indices.
editorial: Restricting matches to seen automatically enforces distinct indices.

tests.explanation: Ten is twice five at a different index.
No pair has one value twice the other.
